description: Curated debunk cards. Plain spoken Chinese for Grandpa, short English lines for demo viewers. Each card is shown as a 4-beat animation: pause -> claim -> truth -> what to do. Have a doctor or pharmacist review these before real use.

generic.myth_zh: 先说你身体出了大问题，再卖你“神药”
generic.myth_en: First scare you about your health, then sell you a "miracle cure"
generic.truth_zh: 这是常见的卖货套路。保健食品不是药物，不能代替药物治疗疾病。
generic.truth_en: A common sales trick. Health supplements are not medicine and cannot replace it.
generic.action_zh: 身体不舒服，找医生。不用急着买。
generic.action_en: Feeling unwell? See a doctor. No need to buy anything.
generic.source_zh: 参考：国家市场监管总局《保健食品标注警示用语指南》

tip_generic.text_zh: 这个说法不一定对，看看就好。身体的事，问医生最靠谱。
tip_generic.text_en: This claim may not be accurate. Enjoy the video, but ask a doctor about health matters.

cards.myth_zh: 每天一杯茶，30天血管就像新的一样
cards.myth_en: One cup of tea a day makes your blood vessels "like new" in 30 days
cards.truth_zh: 没有哪种茶或保健品能把血管“洗干净”。血管斑块要医生检查，按医嘱吃药。
cards.truth_en: No tea or supplement can "wash" blood vessels. Plaque needs a doctor's check and prescribed medicine.
cards.action_zh: 担心血管，去医院查个血脂，不用买这个。
cards.action_en: Worried? Get a blood-lipid test at the hospital instead.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 祖传秘方一个月让血糖降到正常，不用再吃药
cards.myth_en: A secret family recipe brings blood sugar to normal in a month - no more medicine
cards.truth_zh: 糖尿病现在还不能根治。自己停药，血糖会突然升高，很危险。
cards.truth_en: Diabetes cannot be cured yet. Stopping medicine on your own makes blood sugar spike dangerously.
cards.action_zh: 药按医生说的吃，别自己停。
cards.action_en: Take medicine as the doctor says. Never stop on your own.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 早上起床有这3个症状，说明你的肾在衰竭
cards.myth_en: Three morning symptoms mean your kidneys are failing
cards.truth_zh: 口干、乏力、起夜都很常见，大多和肾衰竭没关系。真担心，抽血查个肾功能就清楚了。
cards.truth_en: Dry mouth, tiredness and night-time toilet trips are common and rarely mean kidney failure. A simple blood test answers it.
cards.action_zh: 去医院查一下，比买胶囊靠谱。
cards.action_en: A hospital check beats buying capsules.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 降压药越吃越伤肾，停药也能降血压
cards.myth_en: Blood-pressure pills hurt your kidneys; you can stop them and still lower blood pressure
cards.truth_zh: 按医嘱吃降压药，反而能保护心、脑、肾。自己停药，血压会反弹，容易中风。
cards.truth_en: Prescribed blood-pressure pills protect the heart, brain and kidneys. Stopping them suddenly raises stroke risk.
cards.action_en: Change or stop medicine only with a doctor.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 睡量子能量床垫，高血压、关节痛全好了
cards.myth_en: A "quantum energy" mattress cures high blood pressure and joint pain
cards.truth_zh: 没有科学证据说明这类床垫能治病。“量子”只是听起来厉害的广告词。
cards.truth_en: There is no scientific evidence such mattresses treat illness. "Quantum" is just an impressive-sounding ad word.
cards.action_zh: 床垫睡得舒服就行，治病找医生。
cards.action_en: A mattress just needs to be comfortable. Illness needs a doctor.
cards.source_zh: 参考：中国互联网联合辟谣平台公开辟谣

cards.myth_zh: 祖传偏方，很多人吃了肿瘤消失
cards.myth_en: A secret folk remedy makes tumours disappear
cards.truth_zh: 癌症要去正规医院治疗。相信偏方，可能耽误最好的治疗时间。
cards.truth_en: Cancer needs proper hospital treatment. Folk remedies can waste precious treatment time.
cards.action_zh: 有疑问，去正规医院肿瘤科问问。
cards.action_en: Any concern - ask a hospital oncology department.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 膝盖疼？一贴根治关节炎
cards.myth_en: One patch cures arthritis for good
cards.truth_zh: 关节炎不能“一贴根治”，膏药最多暂时止痛。适当活动、控制体重更有用。
cards.truth_en: No patch cures arthritis; at most it eases pain for a while. Gentle exercise and healthy weight help more.
cards.action_zh: 膝盖疼得厉害，去骨科看看。
cards.action_en: If your knee really hurts, see an orthopaedist.
cards.source_zh: 参考：国家卫健委、科普中国公开科普

cards.myth_zh: 天天喝骨头汤，补钙防骨折
cards.myth_en: Drinking bone soup every day adds calcium and prevents fractures
cards.truth_zh: 骨头汤里钙很少，油和嘌呤倒不少。补钙靠牛奶、豆腐、绿叶菜，再多晒晒太阳。
cards.truth_en: Bone soup has very little calcium but plenty of fat. Milk, tofu, leafy greens and sunshine work better.
cards.action_zh: 防骨折：补钙、练平衡、穿防滑鞋。
cards.action_en: To prevent fractures: calcium, balance practice, non-slip shoes.
cards.source_zh: 参考：中国营养学会、科普中国公开科普
